bosses.name: High Priestess Jeklik
bosses.general: Bat phase: bat swarms, Charge and silencing screech. Troll phase at half health: she heals (interrupt), and bat riders drop fire bombs.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall; pick up the bat swarms.
bosses.healer: Heal through the fire bombs; stay out of the fire.
bosses.dps: Interrupt her Great Heal; kill the bats, step out of the fire.

bosses.name: High Priest Venoxis
bosses.general: Troll phase: Holy Nova, Holy Fire, Renew (dispel it). Snake phase at half health: poison clouds and Venom Spit. Four Razzashi Cobras guard him: kill them first.
bosses.tank: Hold him; in snake form move him out of the clouds.
bosses.dps: Cobras first, interrupt Holy Fire; step out of the poison clouds.

bosses.name: High Priestess Mar'li
bosses.general: Troll phase: spider eggs hatch, Poison Bolt Volley, Drain Life. Spider phase: Enveloping Webs, Charge.
bosses.tank: Hold her and the spiders; she drops threat in spider form.
bosses.dps: Kill the hatchlings, interrupt Drain Life.

bosses.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
bosses.general: Rides his raptor Ohgan. Threatening Gaze: whoever he watches must stand still or be killed. He levels up on kills; spirits revive the dead.
bosses.tank: Off-tank Ohgan; main tank on Mandokir facing away (cleave).
bosses.healer: Stop casting when he watches you.
bosses.dps: Watched: stop casting and attacking and don't move. Focus Mandokir while Ohgan stays off-tanked.

bosses.name: Gri'lek
bosses.general: Edge of Madness: grows and fixates on a random player, Avatar makes him huge.
bosses.tank: Pick him back up after each fixate.
bosses.dps: Kite him if he fixates on you.

bosses.name: Hazza'rah
bosses.general: Edge of Madness: summons Nightmare Illusions and puts players to sleep.

bosses.name: Renataki
bosses.general: Edge of Madness: vanishes and ambushes random players, Thousand Blades.
bosses.tank: Pick him back up when he reappears.

bosses.name: Wushoolay
bosses.general: Edge of Madness: Chain Lightning and Lightning Cloud.
bosses.dps: Spread out, step out of the clouds.

bosses.name: Gahz'ranka
bosses.general: Fished up with Mudskunk Lure: Frost Breath in front, Massive Geyser throws players up.
bosses.tank: Face it away from the raid.

bosses.name: High Priest Thekal
bosses.general: With Zealots Zath and Lor'Khan: all three must die within 10 seconds or they rise. Then Thekal's tiger form: Force Punch, tigers join.
bosses.tank: Three tanks on the three trolls; take Thekal again in tiger form.
bosses.dps: Bring all three down together, then the tiger.

bosses.name: High Priestess Arlokk
bosses.general: Called with the gong. Marks a player for the panthers, vanishes and returns; panthers keep coming from the sides.
bosses.tank: Grab the panthers; pick her up when she reappears.
bosses.dps: Kill panthers on the marked player; burn her when she's out.

bosses.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
bosses.general: Hex on the tank, Brain Wash totems mind control, Healing Wards, and Delusions: cursed players see shades only they can kill.
bosses.tank: Off-tank takes over while the main tank is hexed.
bosses.healer: Dispel the hex; decurse Delusions only after the shade dies.
bosses.dps: Kill the Brain Wash totem and the Healing Ward at once; cursed players kill their shades.

bosses.name: Hakkar
bosses.general: Blood Siphon drains everyone: be Poisoned Blood (from a Son of Hakkar) or you feed him. Corrupted Blood spreads, Cause Insanity, Will of Hakkar mind controls.
bosses.tank: Two tanks; Cause Insanity drops one, the other taunts.
bosses.healer: Keep the poisoned alive before Siphon; spread for Corrupted Blood.
bosses.dps: Kill a Son of Hakkar before each Siphon and stand in its poison; spread out.
